# T-4: Assert worktree root

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Prevent final-regression from running project tests when the execution root is not the active worktree root for a worktree flow.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Root mismatch returns an infra failure before project test command discovery or spawn.
- The mismatch artifact/envelope has `result: "fail"`, `failureKind: "infra_failure"`, `retryable: false`, and `nextAction: "stop"`.

## Implementation Notes
Use resolved real paths for comparison. Keep non-worktree flows unaffected. Surface mismatch through the same final-regression artifact/envelope contract used for other infra failures.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests inject a mismatched worktree flow state and assert the process runner is not called.
